crossRefs.note: There were certain men, who were unclean because of the dead body of a man, so that they could not keep the Passover on…
Yahweh said to Moses, “Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them, ‘A priest shall not defile himself for…
except for his relatives that are near to him: for his mother, for his father, for his son, for his daughter, for his…
“ ‘He who is the high priest among his brothers, upon whose head the anointing oil is poured, and who is consecrated to…
“ ‘ “They shall go in to no dead person to defile themselves; but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for…

translations.web: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die, because his separation to God is on his head.
translations.bsb: Even if his father or mother or brother or sister should die, he is not to defile himself, because the symbol of consecration to his God is upon his head.
translations.kjv: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die: because the consecration of his God is upon his head.
translations.asv: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die; because his separation unto God is upon his head.
